content.short: Rise Wallet is a high-performance, non-custodial wallet for Aptos and Sui focusing on security and a seamless UX.
content.description: Rise Wallet is a leading self-custodial digital asset manager built natively for the high-performance Aptos and Sui blockchains. Developed by the Solrise Research team, the wallet is designed to provide users with a secure and intuitive gateway to the decentralized web. Rise supports advanced features such as real-time NFT management, integrated DEX aggregation for optimal swap rates, and deep integration with the broader Move-based dApp ecosystem. The platform focuses on delivering a responsive and professional-grade user experience typical of centralized applications for users.
content.meta: Rise Wallet is a premier non-custodial wallet for the Aptos and Sui blockchains. Discover Rise Wallet and more on the Lancers Web3 Explorer today.
